records.label: Diablotin ferrailleur
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original ordinary DEMON creature source for Project RL. The user explicitly asks for inspiration from DIABLO II (original classic dark ARPG bestiary, varied recognizable monster families) AND GRIM DAWN (organic grotesque enemies, sinister credible adult anatomy, chitin, dark flesh and leather). Use their dark creature-design discipline, but invent an original species; this is not a named character from those games.
CRITICAL ART CORRECTION: NOT a cute cartoon, not a big-headed frog/ogre toy, not a round mascot. NOT vector art, thick black comic outlines, flat cel-shaded polygon patches, shiny plastic, a smooth candy-colored blob, a children's game character or chibi anatomy. Use mature, lean, predatory or diseased anatomical forms, coherent weight, menacing believable joints and grounded materials. Rendering should suggest a dark classic pre-rendered/painted ARPG game sprite: controlled lit volumes, irregular leathery surfaces, restrained highlights and deep natural creases, without outline-heavy cartoon design.
Native target: a 64px CELL reference, not a universal64px body cap. The subject's intended actual body size is specified below, relative to a player65px tall. It will be exported at native scale with NO review zoom. Favor a strong clear silhouette, two main material regions and a small number of significant internal shapes that survive that size. Keep moderate broad material texture, NOT noisy microdetail, many spikes, dozens of tiny teeth or intricate scales. Anatomy and proportions are more important than piling on ornaments.
Exactly ONE full-body nearly frontal subject, slight overhead ARPG camera, one grounded static pose. Genuine ALPHA transparent background, generous clear margins around every limb, horn, wing, tail and weapon. No sheet, extra views, labels, text, environment, floor, shadow, glow, spell, particles, victims or active attack. Contact shadow will be a separate layer.
This is ordinary demonic rank-and-file, never a boss, leader, ruler or elite. No crown, throne, rank insignia, royal cape, ceremonial gear, heroic posing or giant special boss weapon. No ordinary human, cultist costume or mundane robot. If an object is held, fingers firmly meet its actual grip; no detached weapon.
Choose a grim varied material palette with light enough key planes to remain readable on a dark floor. Dark does not mean a black silhouette. Original cyberpunk-horror setting can use crude industrial metal as a small support material when specified, but never turns every demon into a robot. No dominant neon pink, no oversized shiny eyes, no face made cute.
Static appearance only; no statistics, ability effects, attack timings, spawn density, collisions or animation are defined. One base palette only; keep color regions distinct for later alternate indexed palettes of this SAME drawing.
